mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS remain below 2% for the entire horizon, or during periods of rising CPIAUCSL inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates on equity cash flows and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 2% from below, or during periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE rising above 6.5% from below, or during periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16000).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicate dual accommodative policies, enhancing corporate investment and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS < 2% and INDPRO > 105, or during periods of high consumer spending (PAYEMS > 140000).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 5% from above, or during periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 236).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals monetary easing but faces diminishing returns due to market saturation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods despite FEDFUNDS declining below 2%, or when accompanied by rising CPIAUCSL inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO > 105 and HOUST > 1072, or during periods of high consumer spending (PAYEMS > 140000).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4% from above, or during periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 236).
